11:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: First Take
Stephen A. Smith hosts this weekday morning sports debate show. Smith provides his expert takes on the day's trending sports topics and under-the-radar news. They're regularly joined by veteran analysts and the top guests in sports and entertainment.

13:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: College Football
The UTSA Roadrunners meet the Tulsa Golden Hurricane at the Alamodome in Week 13. First-place UTSA enters at 9-2 after edging UAB 19-17 on Saturday, while 7-4 Tulsa arrives on three straight wins after beating Charlotte 42-14 at home.
